title: Tire rubber derivative 6PPD and 6PPD-Q induce lipid accumulation in hepatocytes through ERRgamma pathway.
authors: Zhang, Shike; Su, Xinyi; Zhang, Jiada; He, Tingting; Tang, Lei; Zhao, Zepei; Cao, Linying
one_liner_zh: 该文研究轮胎橡胶衍生物6PPD/6PPD-Q通过ERRgamma通路诱导肝细胞脂质积累，虽涉及配体-受体结合与分子对接，但核心是核受体ERRgamma而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅分子对接为辅助，与本课题TF-DNA互作建模关联较弱。
abstract: N-phenyl-N'-(1,3-dimethylbutyl)-p-phenylenediamine (6PPD) is a tire rubber antioxidant that can be oxidized to form derivative 6PPD-quinone (6PPD-Q). 6PPD and 6PPD-Q have been detected in human urine with concentrations reaching nanomolar levels. However, their human adverse effects and toxic mechanisms are not explicit. This study elucidated their lipid metabolism disruption effects on hepatic cells (HepG2) and revealed a potential molecular mechanism via estrogen-related receptor gamma (ERRgamma) pathway. The results of fluorescence competitive binding assay showed that 6PPD and 6PPD-Q could bind to ERRgamma with an IC(50) (the concentration of a ligand competing 50 % probe from ERRgamma) of 9 nmol/L and 6 nmol/L, respectively. The reporter gene assay indicated that 6PPD-Q activated ERRgamma in a concentration-dependent mode with the lowest observable effective concentration (LOEC) of 100 nmol/L and the maximum induction rate of 320 %, while 6PPD displayed weak ERRgamma activity. The molecular docking showed that the binding energies of 6PPD/6PPD-Q with agonistic ERRgamma were much lower than those with antagonistic ERRgamma, implying that 6PPD/6PPD-Q tended to display ERRgamma agonistic binding mode. The BODIPY fluorescence staining and triglyceride (TG) assay revealed that 6PPD and 6PPD-Q promoted lipid accumulation and TG production in HepG2 cells with LOEC of 10 nmol/L and 100 nmol/L, respectively. The ERRgamma antagonist (GSK5182) co-exposure reversed the lipid induction effects of 6PPD/6PPD-Q, which confirmed the regulatory roles of ERRgamma. Overall, our study revealed a novel endocrine disruption mechanism of 6PPD and 6PPD-Q via ERRgamma and their hepatic lipid-inducing risks, providing novel information for their health hazard evaluation.
abstract_zh: N-苯基-N'-(1,3-二甲基丁基)-对苯二胺（6PPD）是一种轮胎橡胶抗氧化剂，可被氧化形成衍生物6PPD-醌（6PPD-Q）。6PPD和6PPD-Q已在人类尿液中检测到，浓度达到纳摩尔水平。然而，它们对人类的不良效应和毒性机制尚不明确。本研究阐明了它们对肝细胞（HepG2）的脂质代谢干扰效应，并揭示了通过雌激素相关受体γ（ERRgamma）通路的潜在分子机制。荧光竞争结合实验结果表明，6PPD和6PPD-Q能与ERRgamma结合，其IC(50)（从ERRgamma中竞争50%探针的配体浓度）分别为9 nmol/L和6 nmol/L。报告基因实验表明，6PPD-Q以浓度依赖方式激活ERRgamma，最低可观察效应浓度（LOEC）为100 nmol/L，最大诱导率为320%，而6PPD显示出较弱的ERRgamma活性。分子对接显示，6PPD/6PPD-Q与激动型ERRgamma的结合能远低于与拮抗型ERRgamma的结合能，暗示6PPD/6PPD-Q倾向于呈现ERRgamma激动型结合模式。BODIPY荧光染色和甘油三酯（TG）测定显示，6PPD和6PPD-Q促进HepG2细胞中脂质积累和TG产生，其LOEC分别为10 nmol/L和100 nmol/L。ERRgamma拮抗剂（GSK5182）共暴露逆转了6PPD/6PPD-Q的脂质诱导效应，这证实了ERRgamma的调控作用。总体而言，我们的研究揭示了6PPD和6PPD-Q通过ERRgamma的新型内分泌干扰机制及其肝脏脂质诱导风险，为其健康危害评估提供了新信息。
